title: Docs: What’s new in BC 29 for developers and admins
summary: Business Central 29 (2026 release wave 2) released October 1, 2026 includes new AL methods, testability enhancements, reporting improvements with composite layouts and Word add-in support, interface default implementations, and agentic developer tools with MCP servers for AI-assisted development.
key_points: New AL methods for IsolatedStorage read isolation, ModuleInfo access, Record.IsDirty(), and shared resources via publicResourceFolders
Table extension keys now mix base table and extension fields; four new system flow fields for user names/full names added
Default interface methods allow adding functionality to published interfaces without breaking existing implementors
TestHandlers property enables lifecycle callbacks for cross-cutting tasks; data-driven tests via TestDataSource attribute
Composite Word layouts with header/footer and theme parts; Word Add-in always included in runtime 18.0+ without feature flag
features: ModuleInfo methods for help and resources
System flow fields for user audit trails

quotes.text: Default interface methods let you add new functionality to a published interface without breaking existing implementors.
quotes.why_it_matters: Enables safer evolution of interfaces in production extensions without requiring implementors to update code
